Two paths to add a provider:
1. Open Settings → +Xtream / +M3U / +M3U file, fill in the form.
2. Self-host the Cloudflare Worker from cloudflare-config/, paste this MAC in its dashboard, then in Settings → Set worker URL → Sync from cloud.

Ultra TV is a native Android-TV IPTV client. It speaks Xtream Codes, M3U / M3U8 and M3U files from local storage.
It uses Compose-TV for the UI, Media3 / ExoPlayer for playback, Room for the catalog. D-pad navigation works out of the box.
• Settings → +Xtream / +M3U URL / +M3U file. Fill in the form.
• Or open your Cloudflare Worker dashboard, paste the MAC below, add your providers there, then Settings → Sync from cloud.
Tips you can come back to anytime:
• ★ Default provider switching is in Settings.
• 💤 Sleep timer + 📊 Stream stats live in the player overlay.
• 🔒 Lock individual channels via Settings → Parental.
• 💾 Backup & restore exports providers + favorites + history as JSON.
• 🗓 Guide → Refresh xmltv pulls a 12 h EPG grid.
